title: Detailed lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lemonBody' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF59D'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFEE58'/>
      <stop offset='80%' stop-color='#FDD835'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F9A825'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lemonHighlight' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE7' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leafGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#66BB6A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2E7D32'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stemGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6D4C41'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4E342E'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shadowGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#C0A000' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C0A000' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft shadow under lemon -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='82' rx='30' ry='7' fill='url(#shadowGrad)'/>

  <!-- lemon body with pointed tips -->
  <path d='M22 52
           C18 42, 20 30, 30 25
           C38 21, 46 22, 50 24
           C56 21, 66 20, 74 26
           C82 32, 82 44, 78 54
           C82 64, 80 76, 70 80
           C62 83, 56 82, 50 81
           C42 82, 34 83, 27 78
           C19 72, 20 62, 22 52 Z'
        fill='url(#lemonBody)'/>

  <!-- lemon top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='38' rx='16' ry='11' fill='url(#lemonHighlight)' transform='rotate(-15 42 38)'/>

  <!-- subtle texture dimples -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='1' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.45'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='62' r='1.3' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='56' r='1' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.45'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='70' r='1.1' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='68' r='0.9' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='62' r='1' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.35'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='60' r='0.9' fill='#F9A825' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- left tip nub -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='47' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FBC02D' transform='rotate(-20 20 47)'/>
  <!-- right tip nub -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' fill='#FBC02D' transform='rotate(15 79 50)'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M52 24 C53 18, 54 14, 56 10' stroke='url(#stemGrad)' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M55 14
           C62 8, 72 6, 78 10
           C76 16, 68 22, 58 20
           C56 18, 55 16, 55 14 Z'
        fill='url(#leafGrad)'/>
  <!-- leaf vein -->
  <path d='M57 15 C64 12, 70 11, 75 11' stroke='#A5D6A7' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- small second leaf -->
  <path d='M53 12
           C48 7, 40 6, 35 9
           C37 14, 44 17, 52 15
           C53 14, 53 13, 53 12 Z'
        fill='#43A047'/>
  <path d='M51 13 C46 10, 41 9, 37 10' stroke='#A5D6A7' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- waxy shine streak -->
  <path d='M32 34 C36 30, 44 27, 50 28' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M30 42 C32 38, 36 35, 40 34' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
